events.note: Listing gives 1946 for a 120-foot tower erected by the State Forestry Service. The entry cites a 1936 report, so the year is doubtful.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Tyrrell County entry in the Eastern US Lookouts listing is filed under COLUMBUS. Its county and 120-foot height match this tower, so it is treated as the same tower. No second source confirms the heading.

notes_for_editor: Conflict not resolved: the 1946 build year rests on one listing whose citation (a 1936 report) predates it, so the year is doubtful. The 1954 survey shows a 120-foot tower existed then. Fate and today's condition are not established by any source read. Two search-result pages could not be read in full, so nothing from them is cited: a Facebook post in the search snippet says the tower 'stands 120 ft tall' and calls it the Scotia Fire Tower, while a Mike Legeros photo page snippet calls it an abandoned tower near Columbia. These conflict on the present state and need a direct check of the Legeros page before any 'today' claim is written. No staffing or fire history found.
